Title: Asset Register table lacks horizontal scroll container on mobile viewports (< 768px)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open /dashboard on any mobile viewport width <= 430px (e.g. 320px, 375px, 390px, 430px).
2. Measure document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth.
Expected Behavior: The page body does not overflow horizontally; data table is enclosed in an overflow-x: auto wrapper.
Actual Behavior: Table elements push scrollWidth to 750px-780px across all mobile viewports, creating an unintended 350px-460px 2D scroll. (Previously logged as 4 separate bugs BUG-UI-001..004).
Affected Devices: iPhone SE (320px), iPhone 8 (375px), iPhone 14 (390px), iPhone 14 Pro Max (430px)
Suggested Resolution: Wrap table in <div style="overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; width: 100%;"> and set table-layout: fixed or responsive card view.

Title: Add Asset form layout causes horizontal viewport overflow on viewports < 480px
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open /dashboard/add-product on viewport width <= 430px.
2. Observe horizontal page scroll bar.
Expected Behavior: Form centers within mobile viewport without forcing body horizontal scroll.
Actual Behavior: Form container min-width triggers 20px-90px horizontal scroll on screens under 430px. (Previously logged as 4 separate bugs BUG-UI-005..008).
Suggested Resolution: Set min-width: 0 on form-center container and adjust grid-template-columns: 1fr on @media (max-width: 480px).

Title: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow failure at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Set viewport to 320x800 (representing 1280px display at 400% zoom).
2. Inspect horizontal scrollbar presence on page body.
Expected Behavior: Content reflows vertically into a single column without requiring two-dimensional scrolling.
Actual Behavior: Page requires 2D scrolling. scrollWidth (780px) exceeds viewport (320px) by 460px.
Suggested Resolution: Allow responsive card transformation on tables or enclose wide data in touch-scrollable containers.

Title: Sidebar navigation section headers fail WCAG 1.4.3 minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Inspect .nav-section-title elements in sidebar ('Operations', 'Stock & Setup', 'Management', 'Account').
2. Measure foreground color against background.
Actual Behavior: Foreground color #94a3b8 on background #ffffff achieves contrast ratio of only 2.56:1.
Affected Devices: Users with low vision or high-glare displays
Suggested Resolution: Darken section title token from #94a3b8 to #64748b (achieves 4.6:1 contrast against white).

Title: Accessible name on user menu button does not contain visual text label (WCAG 2.5.3)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Inspect user-menu-trigger button in top navbar.
2. Compare aria-label with visible text in child span.
Expected Behavior: Accessible name contains the string presented visually ('Test Owner').
Actual Behavior: Button has aria-label='Account menu' while visual text reads 'Test Owner', failing Speech-to-Text input voice commands.
Suggested Resolution: Update button to aria-label='Account menu, Test Owner'.

Title: Filter and action select dropdowns lack accessible names (WCAG 4.1.2)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to /dashboard/requisitions and /dashboard/access.
2. Inspect standalone department and status filter <select> elements.
Expected Behavior: All select controls have associated <label for='...'> or aria-label attribute.
Actual Behavior: Bare <select> elements render with no accessible name in assistive technology trees.
Suggested Resolution: Add aria-label='Filter requisitions by status' and aria-label='Filter by department' to select elements.

Title: Focus ring suppressed on interactive form inputs (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Tab to form input on Login or Add Asset.
2. Inspect computed outline style.
Expected Behavior: Visible focus ring with outline-style: solid, outline-width >= 2px and 3:1 contrast.
Actual Behavior: Outline style computed as: none (width: 0px). Uses low-contrast box shadow.
Suggested Resolution: Add :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } to design tokens.

Title: Modal dialog focus trapping allows Tab navigation to escape into background (WCAG 2.4.3)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open any confirmation dialog or modal.
2. Press Tab repeatedly.
3. Observe whether focus moves behind the backdrop.
Expected Behavior: Focus cycles strictly within the modal until closed; Escape key dismisses modal.
Actual Behavior: Focus tabs out of dialog container into background navigation links.
Suggested Resolution: Implement focus trap using inert attribute on background root or React focus-trap library.

Title: Employee role direct URL navigation to /dashboard/access does not gracefully redirect or deny
Detection Method: Playwright Employee role direct URL navigation
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as Employee.
2. Directly enter URL http://localhost:5174/dashboard/access into browser address bar.
3. Observe rendered page.
Expected Behavior: Client router inspects role/permissions and redirects unauthorized employee to /dashboard or displays Access Denied panel.
Actual Behavior: URL loads an unhandled empty or partial state without clear access feedback.
Suggested Resolution: Add permission-based route protection or loader redirect in client router for /dashboard/access.
